nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study proposes macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) using a convolutional variational autoencoder (ConVAE) with 1D convolutional layers. The VAE model learns patterns of macrostructural (tract shape and geometry) and microstructural variation in a healthy population. The encoder consists of four 1D depth-wise separable convolutional layers (kernel size 15, channels 32/64/128/256), and the decoder consists of three layers (kernel size 15, channels 128/96/64). The model was trained with ELBO loss and cyclical annealing on KL divergence. Linear regression was used for group difference testing (MAE ~ Age + Sex + DX).

VAE is considered to be one of many non-linear extensions of dimensionality reduction methods... We previously showed that using this approach, a VAE with 1D convolutional layers (ConvVAE) preserves streamline and bundle distances in the latent space... nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Normative modeling uses four DTI microstructural measures (FA, MD, RD, AxD) projected along tractography streamlines; macrostructure (streamline geometry) is modeled jointly.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: After processing dMRI, diffusion tensors were fitted at each voxel using the non-linear least-squares method to produce FA, MD, RD, and AxD scalar maps in the dMRI native space.; As shown in Figure 2C, MINT is trained on whole-brain macrostructure as well as the four standard DTI microstructural measures.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The VAE-based normative model is unsupervised and learns from streamline coordinates and microstructural features; no explicit explanatory covariates (e.g., age, sex) are specified for the VAE model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In our macrostructure-informed normative tractometry (MINT) framework, a key component is the VAE model, which learns patterns of macrostructural (tract shape and geometry) variation in a healthy population based on the 3D streamline coordinates provided by tractography in addition to the microstructural features along those coordinates.
